descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S12 「Save & Extract 之后 Generate 不再跑第二次任务提取，存着的任务原样不动（PR #50）」 Generate after Save & Extract runs no second task extraction and leaves the stored tasks exactly as they were (PR #50)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Generate AI Note does not run task extraction again and never re-marks or removes tasks (PR #50)（TFA-92592 AC 4；TFA-92585 AC 9；UAT TC-14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both（UAT TC-22 step 4；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident, each with the three UAT tasks typed and one Save & Extract with the UAT bedside text done

When Read the stored tasks (rounding:list / snf:list: A, C), tap Generate Note & Finish and wait for the note, read them again (B, D), while trackActionRequests records every ai/parsing:extractTasks request from the page

Then Zero ai/parsing:extractTasks requests between the Generate tap and the note, in both contexts; B deep-equals A and D deep-equals C (ids, text, done, doneAt): nothing added, closed, reopened or removed

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：T1 (TFA-92592 AC 4, TFA-92585 AC 9). The request count is the discriminating check: an extraction re-run whose result the merge dedups back to the same list still fails it, which a before/after comparison alone would miss. Mirrors the existing spec 'Generate does not send Save & Extract's notes to the extractor again', which covers the medication extractor only, so it is not l …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
